correctness.rationale: Two exact face enumeration algorithms agree on 4,216 masks; a 2,074-pair matching passes an exhaustive directed Hasse acyclicity check on all 17,225 incidences. Exactly one 0-, 51 3- and 15 4-cells remain. Every entry of the signed 51-by-15 integer Morse differential is exactly zero. Since the three-skeleton is a wedge of 51 three-spheres, Hurewicz identifies null degree columns with null 4-cell attaching maps. Independent mod-2 chain ranks corroborate the Betti multiplicities.

value.rationale: The natural 5x5 triangular hard-hexagon torus had known rational homology dimensions but unknown on inspected evidence integral homotopy type. The 4-cell attaching maps could be nontrivial despite those ranks. Their exact nullhomotopy gives a complete wedge classification for a highly symmetric canonical finite lattice, beyond a numerical table, without claiming a general lattice theorem.
